recipes.name: Bean & Oat Burger with Cajun Mayo
instructions: Add the ground flaxseeds and water to a large bowl, mix, and set aside to gel.
Drizzle the oil in a sauté pan over high heat. When hot, add the onion and garlic and sauté until golden. Transfer the mixture to the bowl containing the flaxseeds.
Return the empty pan to the stove and sauté the mushrooms in oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the bell peppers, and chipotle sauce. Cook for another 3 minutes. Set aside.
Returning to the bowl, add the remaining ingredients for the patties. Use a fork to mash everything together, and set aside.
Add the ingredients for the cajun ‘mayo’ to a bowl and mix together.
Scoop up a heaping ½ cup of the bean mixture into your hands and shape them into patties.
Heat some oil in a non-stick large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until lightly golden.
Serve on burger buns with coleslaw, the sautéed mushroom and bell pepper mix, and topped with Cajun mayo, arugula, and jalapeños. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † The chipotle sauce we use is a blend of chipotle peppers with water, vinegar, and spices. It's a deep red-coloured sauce. Some chipotle sauces are mayo-based, and we do not recommend using these versions in this recipe.
Storage Store the cooked bean and oat patties in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days, or in the freezer for up to 2 months.
